block.comment: Purpose: Pass a note record through a variable to the music parser. The same format can come from EEPROM, Serial or an SD line. Wiring: Passive buzzer: PIN D4. Common GND; use each module’s required supply. Try: Replace the note text with another note or a rest, using the same parser.
Create record as String. Outside a body it is global; inside a function/setup/loop it belongs to that body. Its value input is the initial value.
Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.
Interpret one text record, such as C4 250 or R 100. The first value is pitch/rest, the second is milliseconds. Start once when the buzzer is not busy.

The note is text held in a variable. Change F#5 250 to Bb6 100 or R 100. The same input accepts a record read from SD/EEPROM, as in example39. This simple demo repeats; the 400 ms delay just spaces triggers.
